band.title: Before an order
band.pipeline: Before an order, in life order
band.info: Everything of this customer before an order, each record in exactly one group: what the customer is still writing, what waits on us, the quotes on their way, what waits for the customer — then what ended. Each number opens exactly its rows below.
band.failed: The counts could not be read just now: the lists below still show every record.

why.WRITING: drafts in the customer’s portal: read only, never counted as waiting on us
why.TO_ANSWER: requests New or In progress, and portal orders sent: they wait on us
why.PREPARING: quotes in Draft, or Approved and not sent yet
why.WAITING_CUSTOMER: quotes sent, and requests where we asked for more information
why.ORDER_WAITS: the customer said yes; its order is not made yet
why.WON: accepted quotes with their order, requests and portal orders that became an order
why.MOVED: requests and portal orders that became a quote: the quote carries on
why.LOST: quotes declined, expired or cancelled; requests declined, lost or withdrawn; portal orders not accepted or withdrawn
why.OPEN_QUOTES: quotes in Draft, waiting for approval, Approved or Sent

empty.tab: {customer} has nothing before an order yet: no request, no quote, no draft.
empty.tabBody: A request from {customer}’s portal lands here by itself.
empty.incomingNone: No request or portal order from {customer} yet.
